decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a sharp multi-axis shift near index 490–495 with sustained post-shift behavior, and (2) a broad platform in U with an abrupt upward step near 635–637 superposed on rising N and high E. Both show ambiguous partial returns and cross-axis coupling.

regions.observation: N/E/U show a multi-sample shift around index 490–495: N jumps from ~1.9 to ~0.9, E drops sharply from ~0.09 to ~2.23 (positive), U drops from ~0.05 to ~-2.08; followed by a sustained elevated E (~2–5) and variable N/U through ~520, with possible opposing return in U near 530–540 but not fully resolved.

Strong cross-axis coupling visible: after index ~610, N rises steadily while E remains high (~1.5–3.5); U shows a broad negative platform (~-0.5 to -1.2) until ~630, then abrupt upward shift (~+1.5) over 2–3 samples at ~635–637, possibly indicating a temporary offset or opposing motion; surrounding samples show ambiguous recovery.
